type: official documentation and sign-in walkthrough; no credentials created

cues.text: Optional remote setup • This is an Edge documentation walkthrough. Local Desktop Commander and Playwright require no tunnel or OpenAI key.
Install cloudflared, then run: cloudflared tunnel login. Complete sign-in yourself. Keep the resulting certificate and tunnel credentials private.
Create a named tunnel with cloudflared tunnel create YOUR_NAME. Configure only the intended local service. Protect remote access with Cloudflare Access and the gateway bearer token.
For this package: forward only /mcp, use the current loopback port from connection.json, and set httpHostHeader to 127.0.0.1:PORT. Do not expose /config or put a token in the URL.
Optional model setup • OpenAI’s official quickstart links to API keys. Choose your own project and create a secret key. This recording does not create or reveal a credential.
Sign in privately, choose the correct project, and create a key. Save it in VibeSpace’s OpenAI provider settings, never in chat or the MCP connection file. API usage may incur charges.
